current.text: He re-signed with OKC for 3 years and 75 million USD.
He is a projected OKC starter at center next to Chet Holmgren.
The OKC big man group also includes Chet Holmgren, Jaylin Williams and Thomas Sorber. The team used its first pick in each of the last two drafts on a center.
Experts see his role as secure. The new contract, a newly drafted center and a teammate's strong preseason do not change it, and Jaylin Williams barely played unless the centers were out.
He was banged up a lot last season. Before the injuries he played at a top 40 level early in the season, partly while Chet Holmgren was out.
Experts call him the best value target on OKC. He should go inside the top 100 but keeps going too late, especially on ESPN.
His upside depends on minutes and health. With about 28 to 29 minutes he could be a top 60 player. One expert gives a best case of 40th and a worst case of 93rd.
In category mock drafts experts take him around round 8, from about pick 91 to 116, as a useful late center for defensive stats. Josh took him at 97 and later said he regrets it a little.
OKC has a league-minimum 13 back-to-backs. Its schedule is pretty good with a March 28 end.
OKC is projected to win about 62 games and to be a top two seed in the West.

durable.text: He is a good rebounder who adds steals, blocks, a high FG% and unusual assists for a center.
He is a very low scorer. That is fine in a category format, and he can help many fantasy teams but does not fit every build.
His profile is worth more in category leagues than in points leagues.

note: The market has him at Yahoo rank 105 (average cost 1.5 USD) and ESPN rank 132 (1.1 USD). Experts see top 100 value, so with 144 players drafted he is a cheap late center target. He should cost far less than the 11 USD our league paid last season. He fits builds that punt 3PM and want FG%, rebounds, assists and steals from the center spot (61% FG, 9.7 REB projected). Early in the season, check his health and whether his minutes get near 28 to 29, the level experts link to a top 60 season.
